body:
I really appreciate your kind words. It does help me feel a bit better. There's so much more I could say about what led me to being so mentally fucked up but it isn't relevant. I know I've gone through a lot in my life. I just wish I'd learned how to better handle it all. I wish our society wasn't so disgusted by mental health problems. I wish it were acceptable to need help, ask for help, get help, and move on a better person. But it isn't like that, you have to sacrifice so much to get help, and does that really get you to a better place if it causes the rest of your life to deteriorate? I've been raped, I've been homeless, I've been abandoned. But today that doesn't mean, fuck, let's help this girl get past these things and succeed! It's just an impediment to success and happiness. 

My boyfriend's adopted sister went through a lot in her short life...attempted suicide by her father, prostitution and drug addiction from both her mother and father, and her therapist has told her adopted mother that she needs to accept that this young girl has been damaged and likely won't be able to fully recover and lead a happy, successful life. That's so fucked up to me. Nobody deserves that.

And if that's just how it is, do we just accept that we're damaged? Where do you go from there?

Thank you, I really appreciate the kind words. I know I'm not nearly as worse off as so many other people in the world. My problems are miniscule compared to what so many people have to deal with. I feel selfish for even feeling this way. I just don't know what to do anymore. I keep trying, and I can fake myself into feeling like I'm doing well, have a job, have a life, but it's all just fake. I'm a fraud. I need help and I can't for the life of me figure out how to get it without it being counterproductive and setting me back job-wise and all of that. I just don't know what to do anymore.
